description: This file contains functions for interacting with a GraphCMS API, including fetching posts, post details, and handling preview states.

methods.name: fetchAPI
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the GraphCMS API with a query and variables, handling errors and returning data.

methods.name: getPreviewPostBySlug
methods.description: Fetches a post by slug in preview mode, returning the post data.

methods.name: getAllPostsForHome
methods.description: Fetches a list of posts for the homepage with specific fields and image transformations.

methods.name: getPostAndMorePosts
methods.description: Fetches detailed post data along with additional related posts, including images and author info.
